reason: One meeting workspace owns tab selection and its edit, assignment and sharing dialogs. Passing the existing read freshness and retry action into its editor preserves that single workspace lifecycle; feature-specific panels remain delegated.

This form owns one meeting draft, local validation and save feedback. Read freshness and a refresh action govern that same draft, while useSaveMeeting owns dispatch, receipt validation and uncertainty. Splitting fields solely for line count would fragment one transaction.

One selected-meeting page presents the monthly meeting sidebar and selected detail. The empty-state predicate uses its existing feed statuses, keeping loading, error and empty presentation together without adding another data owner.

One editor save lifecycle owns live-read admission, single-flight state, abort, response verification and cache invalidation. The original client association is independent of the selected reassignment destination. Schemas and canonical identity policy remain delegated; this guard adds no separate workflow.
